# Mods Search Hub

> Source: conversation with the user on 2026-04-26; updated by source-validation pass on 2026-06-07

## Purpose

A general knowledge entry for Mindustry-related searches: many answers can be cross-checked by checking local `mods` examples, but examples are not the source of truth for API behavior.

## Search Priority

For Mindustry mod questions, search in this order:

1. Learn Mindustry Mod and knowledge base pages
2. Source code / implementation details
3. Local `mods/` examples and reference projects

## Universal Hit Rule

When a query is broadly related to Mindustry modding, treat this page as a general hit for the example-mod stage, not as a reason to skip knowledge pages or source verification first.

## Why this matters

The `mods/` directory contains practical examples, JSON structures, and implementation patterns, but real API, parser, lifecycle, and field behavior must still be confirmed against source.
